subject: MAP & Eval: hosting pathway, geo split, and commit timeline (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@clearpath.health>, procurement@clearpath.health
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff and eval plan — hosting pathway and geo split

Alyssa / ClearPath team,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our agreement, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP_ClearPath_v1.xlsx) and an SLA draft. High level ask: please confirm your preferred initial hosting mode (Hosted with VPC peering, Dedicated reserve, or Private on-prem) and whether a US-first rollout is acceptable or you need EU presence for the pilot.

To accelerate things, here is the proposed evaluation & close cadence I recommend for your use case (PHI and multi-regional customers):
- Week 0 (by Jul 13): Security questionnaire + SOC2 scoping answers returned by ClearPath
- Week 1 (by Jul 20): Hosted PoC in us-east (shared infra with VPC peering), demo to product & infra teams
- Week 3 (by Aug 3): Cost/latency assessment and recommendation (Hosted vs Dedicated) from Redwood Optimize
- Week 5 (by Aug 17): Legal/procurement review and redlines; target for PO or committed POC credit
- Q4 (tentative): Dedicated/private cutover for full PHI traffic if required

Primary considerations for us to confirm with you:
- Compliance scope: if ClearPath needs an air-gapped or on-prem product we should flag Private earlier
- Latency SLO: if sub-150ms tail is required for patient-facing flows, Dedicated placement may be mandatory
- Data residency: EU region requirement will add a separate parallel MAP track (additional timeline)

Next steps for you: pick hosting preference and confirm whether EU pilot needed. I can lock demo slots for Wed Jul 14 or Fri Jul 16.

Attachments: MAP_ClearPath_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — milestones), SLA-draft-Redwood.pdf (draft SLA)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 415-555-0184

From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@clearpath.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearpath.health
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and eval plan — hosting pathway and geo split

Vanessa, thanks for the clear plan and for capturing the milestones. Quick answers from our side:
- Initial preference: Hosted with VPC peering for the pilot. We want to avoid heavy infra lift for the PoC, but we expect to transition to Dedicated for PHI workloads before full GA.
- Geo: US-first is fine for pilot, but we will need EU coverage for two enterprise customers — would like to understand the delta in timeline and cost for adding eu-west later in the MAP.
- Latency: target sub-200ms P95 for the pilot. If Redwood indicates sub-150ms is required for certain models, we can discuss Dedicated placement then.

Security team will return the completed questionnaire by Jul 12. Procurement will need a redline window of 7 business days — please flag anything in the SLA that tends to be sticky (data deletion, audit windows).

Demo: Jul 16 works best for our product team.

Alyssa Cheng
VP Product, ClearPath Health
alyssa@clearpath.health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff and eval plan — hosting pathway and geo split

Looping in internal ops and recommendations based on Alyssa's note. Summary: Customer picks Hosted w/ VPC peering for pilot, US-first, EU later; target P95 200ms for pilot; security questionnaire due Jul 12; demo Jul 16.

My recommendation (ops + optimize):
- Accept Hosted PoC in us-east with VPC peering. Configure prefix caching and conservative batching to hit 200ms for their expected traffic profile.
- Run a parallel lightweight EU compatibility test (using our eu-west staging region) during PoC. This will give realistic delta for adding EU in the MAP without committing to a full regional rollout immediately.
- If security answers indicate PHI constraints that preclude shared-hosted, escalate to Dedicated planning in Week 2 (target cost model in Week 3).

I'll draft a slimmed MAP summary for the customer that clearly states "Hosted PoC (us-east, VPC peering) -> Evaluate -> Commit Dedicated/private by Q4 if PHI required" and include decision gates.

Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff and eval plan — hosting pathway and geo split

+1 on Marissa's approach. For commercial runway: recommend we offer a 2-month Hosted trial credit to cover PoC costs and a one-time migration credit should they convert to Dedicated. Sales posture: 10% first-year commitment credit if they sign for Dedicated capacity by Sep 30.

I'll loop legal and procurement to prepare redline-friendly SLA. Ben, can you prepare a simple cost delta sheet (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) so we can share in the Jul 16 demo?

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa@clearpath.health>, procurement@clearpath.health
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized MAP summary & next approvals (action required)

Alyssa, thanks for returning the questionnaire and for the call on Friday. Quick summary of what we agreed and the formal MAP items to keep timelines clear: 

Agreed approach:
- Pilot: Hosted with VPC peering in us-east (target P95 <= 200ms) — demo Jul 16 confirmed
- Parallel EU compatibility checks during PoC; EU rollout tracked as separate MAP milestone
- Decision gate: If PHI constraints appear in security review, escalate to Dedicated planning by Jul 23

MAP milestones (please accept or suggest edits):
- Jul 12: Security questionnaire received (completed) — received
- Jul 16: Hosted PoC demo (product + infra) — scheduled
- Aug 3: Performance & cost readout from Redwood Optimize
- Aug 17: Legal/procurement redlines complete; target PO or committed credits
- Sep 30: Target decision to commit to Dedicated capacity for PHI (if required)

Commercials & next steps:
- Redwood will provide a 2-month hosted PoC credit to cover initial usage and a migration credit should you convert to Dedicated by Sep 30 (details in attached MAP file).
- Please review the SLA-draft-Redwood.pdf and send procurement redlines to procurement@redwood.ai. We will circulate a DocuSign for signature once redlines are aligned. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/clearpath-MAP-2027

Action required from ClearPath:
- Reply to this thread with explicit approval of the MAP milestones and acceptance of the demo slot (Jul 16). If approved, procurement can expect the DocuSign envelope the week of Jul 19.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0184
